'''Team Alderaan''' was a [[Limmie/Legends|Limmie]] [[Galactic Cup of Limmie|Cup]] team. Formed from [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]], it counted among its players as of<ref name="Cael" /> [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="Boom" /> one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] fastest athletes, [[Cael Hanarist]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|annihilated]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] as the team was playing in the Cup on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. The news of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] destruction devastated the team, and the Cup was placed on hiatus. The team members broke apart, and Hanarist soon joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Cael" />

==Behind the scenes==
Team Alderaan was mentioned in Cael Hanarist's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
